mechanism_narrative: The mild rebound in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT from t-3w to t-1w implies more out-of-home trip chains; within four weeks this raises retail visits as commuters add discretionary stops after work.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite continued improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above +20 and WORKPLACES remains below -30, time-at-home pressure and remote-work routines reduce discretionary shopping trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above +20 while WORKPLACES stays below -30
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days even though RESIDENTIAL remains above +20 and WORKPLACES remains below -30.

mechanism_narrative: A further week-on-week decline in TRANSIT below its current -38.6 level signals weaker city-centre access, which should continue to suppress retail traffic over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -40 or drops more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior 28-day mean after TRANSIT crosses below -40 or posts a new weekly drop.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM keeps recovering toward zero while RETAIL_REC remains depressed, households are reallocating trips toward essentials rather than discretionary shopping, so retail-and-recreation mobility stays below its recent average over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases within 7 days after GROCERY_PHARM moves above -5 and stays there.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous narrowing of the PARKS deficit and a reduction in RESIDENTIAL staying-at-home implies substitution from home time to out-of-home leisure, which should lift retail-and-recreation mobility over four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or falls over the next 28 days even though PARKS improves and RESIDENTIAL declines from its current level.

mechanism_narrative: In a holiday-shopping regime, rising PARKS and TRANSIT are proxies for broader recreational movement that precedes mall and street-retail visits, producing a positive one-to-two-week lift in RETAIL_REC.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise within 14 days when PARKS and TRANSIT both improve from their current depressed levels.

mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES falls while TRANSIT is also weak, commuting density drops enough to reduce incidental retail stopovers; the effect should appear within one week and persist for four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES drops below -35 and TRANSIT stays below -38
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 days after WORKPLACES and TRANSIT jointly cross the stated thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Under stable restrictions, a continued convergence of all six mobility series toward baseline indicates normalization; because RETAIL_REC is still less negative than t-3w, this convergence should keep retail mobility recovering over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve relative to its last 28-day mean even as the other mobility categories continue moving toward baseline.
